sonnet.problem: This choice card asks about Matthew 13:56 (the sisters), but no earlier story card has told that verse. Card 4 covers only 13:55, and card 6 tells 13:56 afterward. So the card jumps ahead, and its statement also supplies the fact that card 6 tells later.
sonnet.rule: Cards follow the passage in order. A choice card can look back at a verse an earlier card in the same stop told, but never jumps ahead.
